generationInputs.prompt: Eleven food-based recreations of emojis are arranged on a white surface with scattered crumbs. Starting from the top left and moving clockwise: a curved yellow banana shape with rough yellow crumbs; a purple elongated eggplant shape with rough crumbs and a textured green stem; a peach shape with an orange crumb-like texture and a green leaf; a red chili pepper shape with a rough red texture and a green stem; a yellow circle face with two open eyes and a wide open mouth, textured with small yellow crumbs; a diagonally oriented red chili pepper shape; a horizontal red rose shape with green textured leaves and stem; a diagonal rectangular shape with a closed fist outlined in darker yellow and covered in rough yellow crumbs; a yellow circle face with two small, squinting eyes and a slightly open mouth, textured with small yellow crumbs; a similar yellow circular face with two dot eyes and a closed, curved mouth; a vertically oriented purple eggplant shape with a green stem; and a yellow circle face with two dot eyes and a smiling mouth. A light blue diamond shape outlined in black is near the bottom right. Small, loose yellow crumbs are scattered around the food items.
